title: 1 Enoch 81 — The heavenly tablets and the seven holy ones' charge to Enoch

paragraphs.text: ወይቤለኒ፡ ሄኖክ፡ ነጽር፡ ውስተ፡ ጽላተ፡ ሰማይ፡ ወአንብብ፡ ዘጽሑፍ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ፡ ወአእምሮ፡ ኵሎ፡ በበ፡ ኪሉ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-yəbēlanī Henok naṣṣər wəsta ṣəlāta samāy wa-ʾanbəb zaṣəḥuf lāʿlēhomu wa-ʾaʾəməro kwəlo baba kilu

i18n.en: And he said to me: Enoch, look upon the tablets of heaven, and read what is written upon them, and learn everything in detail.

notes.official:
**THE HEAVENLY TABLETS — the cosmic-record of all events past, present, and future.** This verse opens one of the foundational Second-Temple-Jewish texts of the heavenly-tablets motif. The Ge'ez *ṣəlāta samāy* ('tablets of heaven') translates a Second-Temple-Jewish cosmographic-cosmic-record framework that runs across 1 Enoch (1 En 81:1-3 + 93:2 + 103:2 + 106:19 + 107:1), Jubilees (Jub 5:13 + 23:32 + 30:9 + dozens of additional references), and into the Hebrew Bible / Christian-Apocalyptic-NT 'books opened at the judgement' tradition (Dan 7:10; Rev 5:1; Rev 20:12).

The heavenly-tablets are the divinely-inscribed cosmic-record: the catalog of all events past, present, and future, including the deeds of all humans. Enoch's reading-of-the-heavenly-tablets is the cosmographic-revelation that establishes his cosmic-knowledge-of-history. The textual-revelation framework (the cosmic-record as readable-text rather than as purely-cognitive-divine-knowledge) is one of the most-influential Second-Temple-period cosmographic-frameworks.

See central entry `heavenly-tablets-1-enoch-81-jubilees-daniel-revelation-cross-corpus`. The existing v2.66.0 central entry `enoch-as-scribe-mediator-figure-12-jub-4-metatron-cross-corpus` is extended in this Editor pass to include the ENO-WOH-81 refIds.

paragraphs.text: ወነጸርኩ፡ ኵሎ፡ ጽላተ፡ ሰማይ፡ ወአንበብኩ፡ ኵሎ፡ ዘጽሑፍ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ፡ ወአእመርኩ፡ ኵሎ፡ ወአንበብኩ፡ መጽሐፈ፡ ኵሉ፡ ግብረ፡ ሰብእ፡ ወኵሉ፡ ውሉደ፡ ሥጋ፡ እለ፡ ይከውኑ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡ እስከ፡ ለትዉልዶሙ፡ ለዓለም፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-naṣṣarku kwəlo ṣəlāta samāy wa-ʾanbabku kwəlo zaṣəḥuf lāʿlēhomu wa-ʾaʾəmarku kwəlo wa-ʾanbabku maṣḥafa kwəlu gəbra sabʾ wa-kwəlu wəluda śəgā ʾəlla yəkawwənu lāʿla mədr ʾəska la-təwlədomu la-ʿālam

i18n.en: And I looked upon all the tablets of heaven, and read all that was written upon them, and understood all; and I read the book of all the deeds of mankind and of all the children of flesh that shall be upon the earth, unto their generations forever.

notes.official: **Enoch reads the heavenly-tablets — the cosmographic-revelation.** The verse establishes the cosmographic-revelation framework: Enoch reads the divinely-inscribed cosmic-record of all human-deeds, past and future. The 'book of all the deeds of mankind' framework parallels the Jubilees heavenly-tablets framework (Jub 5:13: 'the judgement of all is ordained and written on the heavenly tablets in righteousness') and anticipates the Rev 20:12 final-judgement framework ('the dead were judged from the things written in the books, according to their deeds'). The cosmographic-revelation establishes Enoch as the cosmic-knowledge-bearer: he has read the cosmic-record and can therefore instruct his children (Methuselah and downstream generations) on the cosmic-eschatological situation.

paragraphs.text: ወባረክዎ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ ንጉሠ፡ ክብር፡ ዘገብረ፡ ኵሎ፡ ግብረ፡ ዓለም፡ ወአእኮትክዎ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ በእንተ፡ ትዕግሥቱ፡ ላዕለ፡ ውሉደ፡ አዳም፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-bārakəwwo la-ʾəgziʾabḥēr nəguśa kəbr zagabra kwəlo gəbra ʿālam wa-ʾaʾəkotku-wwo la-ʾəgziʾabḥēr ba-ʾənta təʿgəśtu lāʿla wəluda ʾAdām

i18n.en: And I blessed the Lord, the King of Glory, who has made all the works of the world; and I gave thanks to the Lord because of his long-suffering toward the children of Adam.

paragraphs.text: ወእቤ፡ በበ፡ ጊዜሁ፡ ብፁዕ፡ ዘውእቱ፡ ብእሲ፡ ዘይመውት፡ ጻድቅ፡ ወሠናይ፡ ዘዘፍርደ፡ ኢተጽሕፈ፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ ወዘዕለተ፡ ኵነኔ፡ ኢተረክበ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾəbē baba gizēhu bəḍuʿ zawəʾətu bəʾsi zayəmawwət ṣādəq wa-śannāy zaza-fərda ʾitaṣəḥfa lāʿlēhu wa-zaʿəlata kwənanē ʾitarakba

i18n.en: And I said in that hour: Blessed is the man who dies righteous and good, against whom no record of unrighteousness has been written, and against whom no day of judgment shall be found.

paragraphs.text: ወእልክቱ፡ ሰብዐቱ፡ ቅዱሳን፡ አምጽኡኒ፡ ወአንበሩኒ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡ ቅድመ፡ ዐጸዱ፡ ለቤትየ፡ ወይቤሉኒ፡ ንግሮሙ፡ ኵሎ፡ ለወልድከ፡ ማቱሳላ፡ ወአርኢ፡ ለኵሎሙ፡ ውሉድከ፡ ከመ፡ አልቦ፡ ዘያስተበቍዕ፡ ሥጋ፡ ቅድሜሁ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ እስመ፡ ፈጣሪ፡ ውእቱ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾəlləktu sabʿatu qəddusān ʾamṣəʾuni wa-ʾanbaru-ni lāʿla mədr qədma ʿaḍadu la-bētəya wa-yəbēlu-ni nəgəromu kwəlo la-waldə-ka Mātusālā wa-ʾarʾi la-kwəlomu wəlud-ka kama ʾalbo zayāstabaqqwəʿ śəgā qədmēhu la-ʾəgziʾabḥēr ʾəsma faṭāri wəʾətu

i18n.en: And those seven holy ones brought me and set me upon the earth, before the gate of my house; and they said to me: Tell all things to your son Methuselah, and show all your children that no flesh is justified before the Lord, for he is the Creator.

notes.official:
**THE SEVEN HOLY ONES — the seven archangels — bring Enoch back to earth.** The 'seven holy ones' (*sabʿatu qəddusān*) at 1 En 81:5 are the seven archangels of the broader 1 Enoch corpus — Uriel, Raphael, Raguel, Michael, Sariel/Saraqael, Gabriel, Remeiel (per the canonical-developed list at 1 En 20:1-8). The seven-archangels serve as the heavenly-administrative-attendants who effect Enoch's translation back-to-earth-temporarily for the one-year-instruction-period preamble to the final assumption.

**The one-year-instruction-period.** This verse opens the distinctive 1 En 81:5-9 one-year-instruction-period framework: Enoch is returned-to-earth-temporarily for one year to instruct his son Methuselah, then taken-up-permanently to the heavenly-residence (v. 7). The framework provides the developed-form of the Gen 5:24 taking-of-Enoch tradition: the cosmic-translation includes the cosmographic-cosmic-record-revelation (vv. 1-3), the one-year-instruction-period preamble (vv. 5-9), and the final-assumption — not merely the simple bypass-of-death framing of Heb 11:5.

See central entry `enoch-final-assumption-one-year-instruction-1-enoch-81-cross-corpus` and the bidirectional-extension of `seven-archangels-list-1-enoch-20-tob-12-rev-8-cross-corpus` (extended to add 1 En 81:5).

paragraphs.text: አሐደ፡ ዓመተ፡ እንኅድግከ፡ ምስለ፡ ውሉድከ፡ እስከ፡ ታጸንዕ፡ ዳግመ፡ ወትምህር፡ ውሉደከ፡ ወትጽሕፍ፡ ሎሙ፡ ወትሰምዕ፡ ሎሙ፡ ኵሎ፡ ወትዜንዎሙ፡ ለውሉደ፡ ውሉድከ፡ ካዕበ፡
paragraphs.translit: ʾaḥada ʿāmata ʾənḫədəggə-ka məsla wəlud-ka ʾəska tāṣannəʿ dāgəma wa-təməhər wəluda-ka wa-təṣəḥf lomu wa-təsamməʿ lomu kwəlo wa-təzēnəwwomu la-wəluda wəlud-ka kāʿba

i18n.en: For one year I will leave you with your children, until you have gained strength again, that you may teach your children, write down for them, and testify to them concerning everything; and tell your children's children also.

paragraphs.text: ወበአመ፡ ካልዕ፡ ዓመት፡ ይትነሥኡከ፡ እምነ፡ ምድር፡ ቅድሜሆሙ፡ ወልብከ፡ ይጸንዕ፡ እስመ፡ ጻድቃን፡ ዘጻድቀ፡ ኆሊቆሙ፡ ይከውን፡ ወኃጥአን፡ ይትኄሰሱ፡ ለበበ፡ ኃጢአቶሙ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ba-ʾama kāləʿ ʿāmat yətnaśśəʾu-ka ʾəmənna mədr qədmēhomu wa-ləbbə-ka yəṣannəʿ ʾəsma ṣādəqān zaṣādəqa ḫolaqomu yəkawwən wa-ḫāṭəʾān yətḫēsasu laba-ḫāṭiʾatomu

i18n.en: And in the second year they shall take you from their midst; and your heart shall be strengthened, for the righteous shall be reckoned with the righteous, and the sinners shall be punished for each of their sins.

notes.official:
**Enoch's final assumption — the permanent taking-up.** This verse states the final-assumption event: in the second year (after the one-year-instruction-period preamble of v. 6), Enoch is taken from the human-community permanently. The 'taking from their midst' framework develops the Gen 5:24 *wa-lōʾ ʾēnennû kî lāqaḥ ʾōṯô ʾĕlōhîm* ('and he was not, for the Elohim took him') in the Second-Temple-Jewish cosmographic-cosmic-translation register.

The 1 En 81:7 framework is the textual-fountainhead of the Enoch-Metatron tradition that develops through 2 Enoch (Slavonic Enoch, late 1st c. CE; the angelic-summons-to-translation + the heavenly-ascent through the seven heavens) and 3 Enoch (Sefer Hekhalot, c. 5th-6th c. CE; the identification of the cosmic-translated-Enoch with the enthroned-Metatron). See central entries `enoch-final-assumption-one-year-instruction-1-enoch-81-cross-corpus` and `enoch-as-scribe-mediator-figure-12-jub-4-metatron-cross-corpus`.

paragraphs.text: ወዘይፈቅድ፡ ጻድቅ፡ ለበበ፡ ጊዜሆሙ፡ ይፈጽም፡ ሎሙ፡ ኵሎ፡ ግብረ፡ ሠናየ፡ እንበለ፡ ሐሰት፡ ወእንበለ፡ ኃጢአት፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-zayəfaqqəd ṣādəq laba-gizēhomu yəfaṣṣəm lomu kwəlo gəbra śannāya ʾənbala ḥassat wa-ʾənbala ḫāṭiʾat

i18n.en: And whoever desires righteousness in their times shall accomplish for them every good work, without falsehood and without sin.

paragraphs.text: ብዙኃን፡ ኀጥአን፡ ይተኀጐሉ፡ በውስተ፡ ኃጢአቶሙ፡ እስከ፡ ኵሉ፡ ግብሮሙ፡ ጻድቃን፡ ይኩን፡ ጻድቀ፡
paragraphs.translit: bəzuḫān ḫāṭəʾān yətaḫaggwalu ba-wəsta ḫāṭiʾatomu ʾəska kwəlu gəbromu ṣādəqān yəkun ṣādəqa

i18n.en: Many sinners shall perish in their sins, until all the deeds of the righteous shall be reckoned righteous.

paragraphs.text: ወይእዜ፡ ወልድየ፡ ኵሎ፡ ዘንተ፡ እነግረከ፡ ወእጽሕፈከ፡ ኪያሁ፡ ኵሎ፡ ከሠትኩ፡ ለከ፡ ወአንሣእኩ፡ ለከ፡ ለመጽሐፍት፡ ኪያሆሙ፡ ኵሉ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-yəʾəzē waldə-ya kwəlo zanta ʾənaggərə-ka wa-ʾəṣəḥfa-ka kiyāhu kwəlo kaśatku la-ka wa-ʾansāʾəku la-ka la-maṣaḥəft kiyāhomu kwəlu

i18n.en: And now, my son, I tell you all this and write it for you; I have disclosed all to you, and I have given you the books concerning all these things.
